execution_notes: Sandbox blocks outbound PUT to Higgsfield CDN upload URLs (host_not_allowed), so the local logo PNGs and product photos were referenced via raw.githubusercontent.com URLs (publicly fetchable by Higgsfield and Canva from their servers) instead of Higgsfield media_upload.

Canva MCP perform-editing-operations supports only replace_text, update_fill, insert_fill (images), delete_element, position_element, resize_element, format_text — no insert_text/insert_shape/insert_line. Multi-page editable design 'from zero' was therefore produced via generate-design (AI candidate) + create-design-from-candidate + targeted edits, not via programmatic element-by-element assembly.

All photos in the final design are real Higgsfield-generated images of warm-cream Looniva bamboo viscose bedding in a Tuscan early-morning setting, derived from the Pinterest reference the user provided and adapted to the Looniva HARD RULE no-night-shots palette.

All Italian copy passes the Looniva fact-check filter: no em dashes, no absolute claims, no medical claims, no wellness vocabulary, no superlatives without data, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 cited as a verifiable certification, no thread count number presented as a Looniva product spec.
